source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: قرب عيد ميلاد إمي، وأنا كنت صغير.
sentences.en: My mom's birthday was near, and I was little.

sentences.ar: ما كان معي مصاري أشتريلها هدية.
sentences.en: I had no money to buy her a gift.
I thought a lot about what I could give her.
I decided to make her a gift with my own hands.
I sat drawing and writing for days.

sentences.ar: عملتلها بطاقة، وكتبت فيها كل محبتي.
sentences.en: I made her a card, and wrote all my love in it.

sentences.ar: جمعت ورد من الحديقة، وحطيته بالبطاقة.
sentences.en: I gathered flowers from the garden, and put them in the card.

sentences.ar: يوم عيدها، خبيت الهدية ورا ظهري.
sentences.en: On her birthday, I hid the gift behind my back.
I told her: mom, I have a surprise for you.
I extended my hand and gave her the card.
She read it, and her eyes filled with tears.

sentences.ar: حضنتني بقوة، وقالت: هاي أحلى هدية بحياتي.
sentences.en: She hugged me tightly, and said: this is the nicest gift of my life.

sentences.ar: قلتلها: بس هي بسيطة، ما فيها مصاري.
sentences.en: I told her: but it's simple, it has no money in it.

sentences.ar: قالت: أغلى الهدايا هي اللي من القلب.
sentences.en: She said: the most precious gifts are the ones from the heart.

sentences.ar: من يومها، عرفت إنه المحبة أغلى من كل مصاري الدنيا.
sentences.en: From that day, I knew that love is more precious than all the money in the world.
